entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. My order number is VF8871-B.

Certainly. Let me pull that up. I see you purchased the VeloBand GPS Tracker. I can help with that. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Preference, I guess. It's just... not what I thought.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me a bit more about what you're experiencing? Sometimes a new interface can take a little getting used to.
It's just really hard to use. The whole menu system is confusing. Honestly, I expected more for the price.

I understand the frustration when a new device isn't intuitive. Did you have a chance to look at the quick start guide in the user manual? It has a great diagram of the menu flow that many customers find helpful.
Look, I'm not interested in a tutorial. I've decided I don't want it. Can I return it or not?
Of course. My apologies. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment... Okay, I see the delivery was 33 days ago.

And you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you immediately. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. Once we receive the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Fine. Whatever. Just send the email.
I've just sent that label to the email address on file. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
